questions.question:
다음 중 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 <보기>와 같은 것은?
<보기> terrible - excellent
questions.explanation: <보기>의 terrible(형편없는) - excellent(우수한)은 '반의어' 관계이므로 단어의 관계가 같은 것은 ③ waste(낭비하다) - save(아끼다)가 알맞다. ①, ②, ④, ⑤는 모두 유의어 관계이다.

questions.question:
다음 중 <보기>의 영영풀이에 해당하지 않는 단어는?
<보기>
• feeling sorrow or regret • finished; not happening anymore
• having a good attitude; not negative
• giving a lot of attention to something
questions.explanation: 차례대로 'sorry - over - positive - interested'이다. following(다음의)의 영영풀이는 'coming next(다음에 오는)'이다.

options: I didn't win a scholarship last year.
Did she win the award at the event?
Can she win the gold medal this time?
We can't win any game with the attitude.
Our team will win the first prize in the contest.
questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 단어의 의미가 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?
① I didn't win a scholarship last year.
② Did she win the award at the event?
③ Can she win the gold medal this time?
④ We can't win any game with the attitude.
⑤ Our team will win the first prize in the contest.
questions.explanation: ④의 win은 '이기다'라는 뜻이며 나머지는 '따다[타다/차지하다]'의 의미로 쓰였다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은 몇 개인가?
ⓐ Don't silly again.
ⓑ Bring your own food.
ⓒ We flew to Paris last summer.
ⓓ Did you saw the movie last weekend?
ⓔ They didn't understand my question.
ⓕ Chloe once read books about cultures.
questions.explanation: 어법상 어색한 것은 ⓐ, ⓓ이다. ⓐ silly → be silly (Don't로 시작하는 부정 명령문이므로 Don't 뒤에 동사원형이 와야 하며, silly는 형용사이므로 be가 필요). ⓓ saw → see (일반동사의 과거형의 의문문은 'Did+주어+동사원형 ~?')

questions.question:
다음 Tom의 사진에 대한 설명으로 알맞지 않은 것을 모두 고르면?
① Tom made a cake with his mom.
② Tom bought a new bike last month.
③ Tom were happy in all of the photos.
④ Tom watched a movie again two weeks ago.
⑤ Tom didn't went shopping with his friend yesterday.
questions.explanation: ③ were → was (주어 Tom은 3인칭 단수이므로 was로 고쳐야 함). ⑤ went → go (일반동사 과거형의 부정문은 'didn't[did not]+동사원형'이므로 go로 고쳐야 함).

questions.question:
다음 중 짝지어진 대화가 어색한 것은?
① A: What's wrong?
   B: My legs hurt.
② A: We didn't win any prizes. B: I'm happy for you.
③ A: You know what? My team won! B: Congratulations!
④ A: I won the first prize in the contest. B: That's great.
⑤ A: We lost the game because of me. I'm upset. B: That's too bad.
questions.explanation: 아무 상도 타지 못했다는 안 좋은 소식을 말한 상대방에게 '잘됐다'고 말하는 것은 어색하다. 상대방에게 위로하는 말이 되어야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 대화를 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
W: You don't look well, Alex. What's wrong?
B: Sumin and I worked on a project for the science fair.
W: I know. It was about green energy. Right?
B: Yes. The fair was yesterday, and we didn't win any prizes.
W: Oh, I'm sorry to hear that.
B: I'm so sad, Mom. We worked really hard for it.
W: Cheer up, Alex. You did your best.
B: Yeah, and we learned a lot about green energy, too. Thanks, Mom.

위 대화의 내용과 일치하는 것을 <보기>에서 모두 골라 짝지은 것은?
<보기> ⓐ Alex's mom is cheering him up.
ⓑ Alex won a prize at the fair thanks to Sumin.
ⓒ Alex worked on the project about green energy.
ⓓ Alex went to the science fair with his mom yesterday.
ⓔ Through the science fair, Alex got knowledge about green energy.
questions.explanation: ⓐ, ⓒ, ⓔ가 일치한다. ⓑ는 상을 타지 못했다는 점에서 거짓이고, ⓓ는 수민이와 함께 참가했다는 점에서 거짓이다.
